name: Pemberton
bio: Puts the kettle on between rounds. Has never once missed tea, or a flank.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch): a textured GLB in a T-pose despite its name, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A soldier in multi-terrain camouflage, body armour and a helmet.
